newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint steady vs basket, not seen hit by BUX fall.
newsitem.headline: Forint steady vs basket, not seen hit by BUX fall.

text.p: The Hungarian forint remained steady against the central bank's dollar/mark currency basket on Monday and was seen unaffected by falls on the Budapest Stock Exchange, dealers said.

The forint finished right on the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) resistance level at 196.60 to the dollar, compared with 195.95 at midday and 195.75/80, as the dollar/mark strengthened internationally after weekend falls.
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5 percent wide intervention range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
Dealers said Monday's 3.17 percent fall in Budapest's BUX stock index was unlikely to provoke a spate of hard currecy buying as it was not related to any Hungarian factors.
"Today's fall in the BUX Index is exactly in line with global falls and investors are still positive about Hungary so I don't expect forex buying," said Ervin Csengeri of Inter-Europa Bank.
The Hungarian stock market kicked off the week's trading in sharp decline, moving in the same direction as other markets in Europe. The BUX index finished at 7,552.00 points, down 247.02 points.
